title: Data dependent Shepard approximation through and adaptive modification of the shape parameter
summary: In this article, we introduce a novel data-dependent Shepard interpolation method inspired by the adaptive strategies proposed in [2]. In this case, as Shepard interpolation does not produce oscillations, our approach has the core objective of reducing the smearing near jump discontinuities in the data in one and two dimensions. While the original work in [2] focuses in on Radial Basis Function (RBF) interpolation, we extend these ideas to the Shepard framework by incorporating a data-dependent adaptation mechanism.
